plain.li: [truce,warm,war] We are as tired of this as you are, {WRITER}. Our envoy will come to your gate to swear it.
[truce,cordial,war] Your terms are fair. We will send someone to your gate to swear them.
[truce,cool,war] We have read your terms. We will send someone to your gate to swear it, and no more than that.
[truce,cool,war,theirLowtech] Our people talked late into the night about your words. We will come to your gate under our sign of parley.
[truce,cool,war,theirHightech] Your terms are acceptable. Expect our envoy at your gate, and see that nobody on your walls gets nervous.
[truce,cool,call] Fine. We'll send someone to your gate to make it official.
[truce,refusal,war] You beat one band of ours and think we will beg. We will not.
[truce,refusal,war,theirLowtech] We will not come to your gate under a sign of parley. Not this season.
[truce,refusal,war,theirHightech] Your terms were discussed and rejected. That's all.
[truce,refusal,call] No truce, {WRITER}. Don't call about it again.
[pact,warm] We hoped you would ask, {WRITER}. My people will be glad of it.
[pact,warm,theirLowtech] It is a good thing to stand together. We will make the oath and keep it.
[pact,warm,theirHightech] Consider it signed on our side. We look forward to the year.
[pact,cordial] We've talked it over, and we accept, {WRITER}.
[pact,cordial,call] Good to hear from you, {WRITER}. Yes, we'll do it.
[pact,cool] We'll agree to it. Let's see how the year goes.
[pact,refusal] It's too much to promise right now, {WRITER}. Ask us again another time.
[pact,refusal,theirLowtech] Those who lead us are not ready to swear to that. In time, perhaps.
[pact,refusal,theirHightech] Our council voted against it this time. It may come up again next year.
[greetings,warm,tie:pact] Thank you for writing, {WRITER}. Our pact is the talk of the town in a good way.
[greetings,cordial,tie:pact:defence] Good to hear from you. Our people know your colony stands with us, and we with you.
[greetings,cordial,tie:pact:trade] Thank you for your letter. The traders here already count on your colony's cart each season.
[news,cordial,tie:pact] Here is our news, and since we are pact-bound, I'll tell you more than I tell most.
[warning,warm,tie:pact:defence] A warning from a friend under the pact is worth twice one from a stranger. Thank you.
[greetings,cool,tie:pact:due] We have your letter. Our minds are on the call between our peoples just now.
[greetings,cool,tie:truce] The truce holds, and we have your letter. That is about as far as things go between us.
[greetings,curt,tie:truce,theirLowtech] A sign of parley doesn't make friends. Still, we read your words.
[news,cool,tie:truce] You want our news while the truce holds. Very well, a little.
[greetings,cordial,tie:truce:due] The truce runs out soon. I would not mind if it ended in a peace, {WRITER}.
[parley,us] You came under the sign of parley, and you'll leave under it.
[parley,us] Let's have it done, then, and nobody else hurt.
[parley,us,theirLowtech] We accept the sign of parley you carried here.
[parley,us,theirHightech] Let's go over the terms one more time.
[parleyterms,them] My people will keep their raiders off your land while it lasts.
[parleyterms,them] These are the terms we agreed, and I'll swear to them.
[parleyterms,them,theirLowtech] My people send me under this sign of parley, with their word.
[parleysworn,them] It is sworn, and my people will hear of it tonight.
[parleysworn,them] Sworn, then, and may it hold.
[parleysworn,them,theirHightech] Done, and witnessed on both sides.
[pactask,us] I'd like to talk about a pact between our peoples.
[pactask,us] Our peoples could do more together than apart.
[pactask,us,theirLowtech] Would those who lead you swear an oath with us?
[pacttalk,them] That's a big thing to promise for my people.
[pacttalk,them] What would your colony give in return?
[pacttalk,us] We'd keep our side of it, every season.
[pactyes,them] Then it's agreed, and I'll tell my people so.
[pactyes,them,theirLowtech] Then it is sworn between us, and I'll carry it home.
[pactno,them] I can't promise that for my people, not yet.
[pactno,them] Ask me again when we know each other better.
